resources.string: Guests with a CEPT licence may operate for up to 3 months with class B privileges; class A requires proof of CW knowledge (min. 5 wpm).
The EJ prefix is for offshore islands.
Guests with a CEPT licence may operate for up to 3 months.
A class licence lets guests with a CEPT licence operate for up to 365 days on all amateur bands without additional permits.
PJ4 – Bonaire, PJ5 – St. Eustatius, PJ6 – Saba.
Guests with a CEPT licence may operate for up to 90 days on all amateur bands without permits or registration.
In Peru, OA with the zone digit is appended at the end of the callsign (e.g. SP3WRO/OA4).
